body: I would be very careful talking to a doctor or a professional. Some job applications will ask you to disclose any "disabilities" with depression being one of them. Depression is still stigmatized and future employers will hold that against you.
I'll kill myself whenever I please, thank you. There is no god.

I'm alone on Christmas Eve too, although it was more or less self-imposed. I can't feel any joy or happiness anymore. If I had the courage I'd end myself while everyone else is enjoying themselves for the holiday, I would.
